cases.name: Hope “Onyx” Cornish
cases.about:
Her mother (Crystal Thompson) said she wants her daughter remembered for the life she lived, not the tragedy that took her. 

"I don't want people to just see a name and not know who she was," Crystal Thompson told KTVB on Thursday. "She was a fiery one. She was just very stylish, and she was kind and loving."

Thompson said she dated Cornish for a long time, and the kids moved in with him in the last couple of years so she could better care for her youngest, who has autism.  "Dell wasn't her biological father, no, but he was dad like he has been there since day one, and he signed the birth certificate," Thompson said. "I never, never thought that we weren't safe physically around him."
cases.narrative:
When her 15-year-old brother Lucien got home from school that afternoon, he immediately knew something was very wrong. His father asked him about his day and then told him that he’d killed Onyx. As Lucian would later tell law enforcement, he was in “absolute shock." He asked his father what he was talking about, which is when Cornish pulled out a handgun telling his son to go into his sister’s room and see that she was dead. Lucian refused, begging his father to let him leave. The pair fought over the gun and Lucian was able to get it away from his father before dropping the gun, running from the home and calling 911.

The affidavit states police arrived at the home and swept the house. Hope Cornish was found fatally shot with a Pride flag draped over her, because Delbert Cornish said it was important to her, and a way to "honor her." 

Her cat was also found shot dead.
